text:
Sophie: Customer report — their rerank call is returning a 413 with a vague message. They sent ~3k docs (avg 800 chars/doc) + 2k char query. Customer says error text is 'Request body too large' with no guidance. Can we confirm limits and next steps?
Kevin: Can you paste the raw request payload size + sample header? also which sku/region they hit? :eyes:
Sophie: Payload size shows 2.4MB compressed? they sent to hosted-us-west. I have the request id: req_0x9f3a. Logged at 2026-03-12T15:02Z. I'll attach the anonymized payload here.
Maya: quick triage: the runtime returns 413 when the body payload > 1,048,576 bytes (1MB) OR when tokenized total > 200k tokens for rerank path. Logs for req_0x9f3a: 
```
ERROR reranker.service: req_0x9f3a - payload_bytes=2494821 token_estimate=218345 error=PayloadTooLarge
stack: /srv/runtime/serve.py:142
```
So both thresholds are crossed.
Ian: Is the error text coming from proxy or our service? that determines what the customer sees.
Maya: It's our gateway returning generic nginx 413 because the request body exceeded the configured client_max_body_size. The reranker service then also logs token_estimate over limit but the customer only saw the nginx error.
Kevin: Ok that explains the vague UX. Action items: 1) short-term: help customer with client-side chunking & give explicit guidance; 2) medium-term: change gateway message to include structured info when our auth/gateway detects rerank path; 3) long-term: consider accepting streaming uploads for large docsets or support file refs.
Sophie: Customer wants exact numbers to code against. Can we confirm the authoritative limits to pass back?
Maya: Current hosted defaults: max_payload_bytes=1_048_576; max_total_tokens_rerank=200000; max_docs_per_request=1000; max_doc_chars_heuristic=12000 (we do a soft-limit per doc to avoid extreme token spikes). Note: token estimate is model-aware; these are conservative server-side caps.
Ian: Recommend we publish these in KB and also return a JSON body like: {"error":"payload_too_large","reason":"total_tokens_exceeded","max_tokens":200000,"suggestion":"chunk_docs"} instead of plain 413 text. I'll open a small ticket for gateway change.
Kevin: For now here's a minimal client-side recipe to chunk by doc count + estimated tokens (send in batches of 250 docs or <= 500k chars):
```
# pseudocode: python
from math import ceil
BATCH_DOCS = 250
for i in range(0, len(docs), BATCH_DOCS):
    batch = docs[i:i+BATCH_DOCS]
    resp = client.rerank(query, batch)
    collect(resp)
```
If the customer needs ranked scores across all docs, we can advise them to merge results and re-rank client-side by score.
Sophie: Customer also complained scores were unexpected when they tried naive chunking (score ranges differed between batches). Any suggestion?
Maya: Rerank model scores are relative to the batch. To produce globally comparable scores either: 1) include a small set of anchor docs in every batch (stable seed docs) so scores calibrate, or 2) run an additional pass with the top-N candidates aggregated and re-rank them together (recommended).
Ian: We should add a KB snippet: "If you are sending large doc collections, batch them, keep batches small, and do a final tie-break re-rank on aggregated top results." I'll add that to the support KB.
Kevin: Draft customer-facing message (short): "Error 413: request too large. Our rerank endpoint limits total request size and token count. Try sending fewer docs per request (suggestion: <=250 docs or <=500k chars) or send doc references instead. If you need higher limits contact support with your use case."
Sophie: Nice — can you include the suggestion about anchor docs and the top-N merge?
Kevin: Updated short message: "Error 413: request too large. Reduce docs per request (recommended <=250 docs) or aggregate top candidates client-side. If you need help splitting your corpus or have a business case for a higher limit, reply with sample size and we can evaluate dedicated capacity."
Maya: I'll also propose a small change to the 413 page to include a link to a KB article with chunking code samples and the exact caps.
rerank-bot: NOTE: ticket #SR-7641 created for gateway 413 improvements (assigned to @Ian).
Sophie: Thanks team. I'll send the customer the guidance and offer to help with a snippet. Will update when they try the chunking. :thumbsup:
